email.staffInvite.subject: Your HandyHub staff account
email.staffInvite.body:
You have been invited to the HandyHub staff app.

Set your password with this link. It works once and expires in {hours} hours:
{url}

If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.
email.staffReset.subject: Reset your HandyHub staff password
email.staffReset.body:
Someone asked to reset the password of your HandyHub staff account.

Choose a new password with this link. It works once and expires in {hours} hours:
{url}

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.
signIn.heading: Staff sign-in
forgot.heading: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your staff account. If it belongs to an account, we send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email belongs to a staff account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once.
setPassword.hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
setPassword.done: Your password is saved. Sign in with your new password.
setPassword.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask the owner for a new invite, or request a new reset link.
error.CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.
error.NOT_CONFIGURED: This is not set up yet. Ask the owner.

security.recommended: An authenticator app is recommended for your account. It keeps your account safe even if your password is guessed.
security.enrolled: Your authenticator app is set up.
security.notEnrolled: No authenticator app is set up.

security.recoveryIntro: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
security.reauthIntro: Enter your password again to continue.

system.unavailableBody: Nothing on this screen is known to be healthy until it loads.
system.health.intro: Read from what the system records. Anything it cannot observe shows as unknown or NOT CONFIGURED, never as OK.
system.health.loadFailed: System health could not be loaded.
system.health.testDestinationCounts: {emails, plural, one {# email address} other {# email addresses}}, {phones, plural, one {# phone number} other {# phone numbers}}
system.health.listLimit: Each list below shows the newest 20.
system.config.intro: Every decided value is active, versioned configuration citing its decision. A missing fact shows as NOT CONFIGURED and is never invented. This view is read-only.
system.config.loadFailed: The configuration could not be loaded.
system.config.variablesIntro: Set by the owner in Render. Only whether each one is set is shown; values are never shown.
system.config.variablesUnknown: This process was not given its environment, so which settings are set is unknown.
request.actionDone: Done. The request has moved on.
request.actionUnavailable: Not available for this request now, or not part of your role.
request.askHint: This only records that the customer needs to answer questions; no message is sent to the customer now. To ask, publish the question under Questions to the customer: that sends the automatic notice.
request.customerPreference: Customer's stated preference: {preference}. Staff confirm the approach.
request.customerReasonHint: Finish the sentence "We're unable to take on this project because …". Do not name other companies.
request.notAFitHint: If work was accepted, an appointment exists or money was received, this goes to the Owner for cancellation and financial review instead of closing.
request.notesHint: Staff only. Never shown to the customer and kept apart from customer messages.
request.onlineHint: The estimate is written next; nothing is sent to the customer now.
request.originalHint: Exactly as the customer sent it. It cannot be edited.
request.qualificationHint: Staff check each point; AI classification is off. Both estimating routes need every point answered.
request.refused: This was not done. What is needed:
request.routedToOwner: Sent to the Owner for cancellation and financial review. Nothing was closed.
request.spamHint: The quiet spam controls flagged this request. Review it like any other; nothing was discarded.
request.visitExplanationHint: Why a site visit is needed, in English.
request.visitHint: No visit is booked and no message is sent now; the visit windows are offered next.
request.workPackagesHint: One project; each service becomes its own work package.
requests.loadFailed: The requests could not be loaded. Try again.
enum.requestNextStep.qualify_and_choose: Qualify the request and choose an action
enum.requestDecision.not_a_fit_owner_rev: Not a Fit, sent to the Owner for financial review
enum.coverageResult.out_of_coverage: Outside the service area; staff decide

enum.requestRefusal.REASON_REQUIRED: A written reason or explanation is required.
enum.requestRefusal.OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRE: Accepted work, an appointment or money exists; this goes to the Owner.
enum.requestRefusal.FACTS_MISSING: The server could not check everything it needs. Try again.
enum.requestRefusal.ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED: This action cannot be taken by staff.

customers.searchHint: Name, exact email, phone or project reference.
customers.loadFailed: The customers could not be loaded. Try again.
customers.possibleDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# possible duplicate} other {# possible duplicates}}
customer.heading: Customer {name}
customer.notAvailable: Not available yet: these records are added in a later release.
customer.reasonHint: Required. Kept with the change; staff only.
customer.stale: Someone changed this record meanwhile. Nothing was saved; the current record is shown.
customer.invalid: Check the highlighted values and try again.
customer.merged: This record was merged into another one and is no longer edited.
customer.permissionsHint: A phone number is never permission to text. Marketing is a separate permission.
customer.consentSameDestination: Recorded for the same email or number outside this contact.
customer.editContactHint: A changed email or phone is unverified until the customer verifies it.
customer.textNeedsOptIn: Text as the preferred channel needs a current SMS opt-in for this number.
customer.recordOptOutHint: Record what the customer asked for. Staff never record an opt-in for the customer.
customer.optOutReasonHint: Required: how and when the customer asked.
customer.candidatesHint: Suggestions only: a shared email, phone or address is never proof that two records are the same person. Nothing is merged or linked automatically.
customer.dismissHint: Required: why these are different customers. Nothing is changed on either record.
customer.notesHint: Staff only. Notes are never shown to the customer and are kept apart from customer messages.
customer.noteHint: Never write passwords, access codes or card numbers in a note.
customer.noteMasked: Restricted note: not shown to your role.
customer.noteSensitive: This looks like a card number. Card numbers never go in a note.
customer.historyTruncated: Only the newest entries are shown.
enum.queueReason.message_needs_linking: An inbound email or text could not be matched to exactly one project: link it, never by name alone
enum.queueReason.customer_replied: The customer sent an email or text on this project
enum.queueReason.question_replied: The customer replied to a question
enum.queueReason.reopened_by_reply: The customer's reply reopened a closed request
enum.queueReason.no_response_close_avail: No reply after the final reminder: you may close it
enum.matchRule.reply_token: Matched by the project's reply address
enum.matchRule.latest_conversation: Matched to the latest open conversation
enum.needsLinkingReason.no_match: No verified contact or reference matches
enum.needsLinkingReason.no_open_project: The customer has no open project
enum.needsLinkingReason.sender_not_on_pr: The sender is not a contact of the referenced project
enum.needsLinkingReason.returned_by_staf: Returned to Needs Linking by staff
enum.bodyState.html_converted: HTML-only email: shown as plain text
enum.bodyState.not_retrieved: The email text was not retrieved: email is not configured
enum.bodyState.retrieval_failed: The email text could not be retrieved
inbox.loadFailed: The inbox could not be loaded. Try again.
inbox.notConfiguredSms: Texts are not received until the owner sets BIRD_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Nothing is shown as received.
inbox.notConfiguredEmail: Email is not received until the owner sets RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Nothing is shown as received.
inbox.bodiesNotConfigured: Email text cannot be read until email (Resend) is configured; messages arrive without their text.
inbox.bodiesFake: Test server: email text comes only from synthetic test messages.
inbox.replyTokensNotConfigured: Set INBOUND_EMAIL_ADDRESS so project emails carry their reply address; until then replies match by thread and verified email only.
inbox.unsupported: {count, plural, one {# message arrived on an unsupported channel} other {# messages arrived on unsupported channels}}
inbox.unsupportedHint: The inbox handles texts and email only; check those messages in the provider's dashboard.
inbox.needsLinkingIntro: Private to the Owner and Office. These messages are attached to no customer until you link them.
inbox.notFound: No conversation or inbound message has this ID, or it is outside your access. A failed notification is retried from the action queue.
inbox.truncated: Long message: only the beginning is kept.
inbox.subject: Subject: {subject}
inbox.attachmentsNotImported: {count, plural, one {# attachment was not imported; open it in the provider's dashboard.} other {# attachments were not imported; open them in the provider's dashboard.}}
inbox.customerMessagesIntro: The customer's email, texts and portal messages exactly as received, and the replies sent from this project.
inbox.noNotifications: No notifications recorded for this project.
inbox.internalIntro: Staff only. Internal messages never reach the customer and never change scope or price.
inbox.internalHint: Never write passwords, access codes or card numbers in a message.
inbox.originalIntro: Kept exactly as received; linking never changes it.
inbox.linkIntro: Link only when you are sure who sent it. A shared email or phone or a name is never proof; the correction and your reason are recorded.
inbox.noCandidates: No project has a contact with this address.
inbox.stale: This message changed meanwhile. It was reloaded; check it and try again.
inbox.cardNumber: This looks like a card number. Remove it; card numbers are never written in messages.
inbox.alreadyOnProject: The message is already on that project.
inbox.invalid: Check the reference and the reason.
inbox.linkNeeds: Enter a project reference and a reason.
questions.title: Questions to the customer
questions.noticeHint: Publishing a question sends the customer the automatic notice “HandyHub has a question about your request. View and reply securely.”, with a link to the question. No second approval is needed.
questions.cadence: Reminder drafts are prepared {first} hours and {final} hours after the notice was sent; staff release each one and it sends within the contact hours. You may close the request “Closed—no response” {close} hours after the final reminder was actually sent.
questions.cadenceNotConfigured: The reminder schedule is NOT CONFIGURED: no reminder is prepared.
questions.noticeFailedHint: The notice was not sent. Reminders start only once it is sent; a failed notice never counts as no response.
questions.released: Reminder released. It sends within the contact hours, after a last check.
questions.textHint: The customer reads it exactly as written, in English. Never ask for passwords, access codes or card numbers.
questions.measurement: Measurement: the customer may answer “I'm not sure”
questions.hazardWarning: Never ask the customer to go into, open or inspect a hazardous area. Ask only for what they can see or photograph safely; if something needs a closer look, arrange an estimate visit instead.
questions.hazardConfirm: This question does not ask the customer to inspect a hazardous area.
questions.published: Question published. The customer is notified automatically.
questions.cardNumber: This looks like a card number. Remove it before publishing.
questions.loadFailed: The questions could not be loaded. Reload the page.
questions.reopenUntil: A customer reply until {time} reopens this request for review.
questions.closeHint: The request and project close with their history. Accepted, scheduled or paid work is never closed this way. A customer reply within the reopen period reopens the same request.
enum.deliveryError.template_not_configur: Not sent: no approved wording for this message yet.
enum.deliveryError.channel_not_configure: Not sent: this channel is not configured.
enum.deliveryError.template_values_missi: Not sent: the approved wording needs a value this message does not have.
enum.deliveryError.sms_no_opt_in: Not sent: the customer has not agreed to texts.
enum.deliveryError.sms_opted_out: Not sent: the customer opted out of texts.
enum.deliveryError.record_changed: Not sent: the customer's contact details changed after Send.
enum.deliveryError.not_on_test_allowlist: Not sent: this test server sends only to approved test addresses.
enum.deliveryError.invalid_destination: Not sent: the address or number is not valid.
inbox.reply.heading: Reply to the customer
inbox.reply.intro: Pressing Send releases the reply: it is added to the customer's project page at once, and its email or text goes through the channel below. Internal notes belong in the internal conversation, never here.
inbox.reply.noContact: This project has no contact to reply to.
inbox.reply.noChannel: No channel is permitted for a reply: the customer's email must be verified, or their phone verified with a text opt-in.
inbox.reply.preferredCall: The customer prefers phone calls. Choose a permitted channel for this written reply.
inbox.reply.preferredUnavailable: The customer's preferred channel ({channel}) can't be used: {reason}. Choose another permitted channel.
inbox.reply.hoursOpen: Inside contact hours ({open}–{close}, {zone}): the email or text goes at once.
inbox.reply.hoursClosed: Outside contact hours ({open}–{close}, {zone}): the email or text waits until {time}. The reply shows on the customer's project page at once.
inbox.reply.hoursNotApplied: Replies are not held to contact hours: the email or text goes at once.
inbox.reply.hoursNotConfigured: Contact hours are not configured: the email or text goes at once.
inbox.reply.templateMissingEmail: No approved wording for reply emails yet: the reply is saved on the project, and its email is recorded as not sent until the wording is released.
inbox.reply.templateMissingSms: No approved wording for reply texts yet: the reply is saved on the project, and its text is recorded as not sent until the wording is released.
inbox.reply.label: Reply
inbox.reply.hint: Written to the customer, in English. Never write passwords, access codes or card numbers. Up to {max} characters.
inbox.reply.sent: Reply sent. It is on the customer's project page.
inbox.reply.keptDraft: The reply could not be sent. It is kept here; try again and it is sent only once.
inbox.reply.channelChanged: The customer's channels changed meanwhile. They were reloaded; choose again.
inbox.newConversation: No messages on this project yet. Your reply starts the conversation.
estimates.intro: Every estimate is written for one project. Open one to continue its draft.
estimates.empty: No estimates yet. Write one from a request that is ready for an estimate.
estimates.loadFailed: The estimates could not be loaded.
estimates.noneForProject: No estimate has been written for this project yet.
estimates.writeHint: Starts a new draft for this project. Nothing is sent to the customer.
estimate.heading: Estimate {number}
estimate.mailingAddressOmitted: Not provided: the address line is left out.
estimate.validityDays: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from publishing
estimate.customerPdfHint: Generated on the server in English from the saved version and the configuration, as the customer receives it. Save the draft first to include your latest changes.
estimate.upload.title: Estimate document
estimate.upload.hint: A PDF or Word (.docx) file of up to {mb} MB. It is kept private and unchanged; the customer sees a PDF.
estimate.upload.pdfRequiredText: A Word document cannot be converted faithfully here. Upload the PDF of the same document: the customer sees that PDF and the Word original stays private.
estimate.upload.copyHint: A copy of the uploaded PDF, byte for byte; the original stays private.
estimate.agreement.title: Do the document and the amounts agree?
estimate.agreement.amountsPending: The amounts appear when every line has a quantity and a price.
estimate.agreement.amounts: Structured amounts: total {total}; deposit {deposit}; valid for {validity}.
estimate.agreement.label: I checked that the document and the structured amounts agree (total, options, deposit and validity).
estimate.agreement.confirmedBy: Confirmed by {name}, {time, date, medium} {time, time, short}.
estimate.agreement.hint: Publishing an uploaded estimate needs this confirmation. Saving the amounts or uploading a document clears it.
estimate.notEditable: This version can no longer be edited.
estimate.notFound: This estimate could not be found, or you may not open it.
estimate.linesHint: Write the lines of each work package. Leave a quantity empty while it is unknown; amounts and totals are computed on the server when you save.
estimate.linesHintUploaded: Enter the amounts exactly as the document states them, as lines: the base scope (for example one line, quantity 1, at the document's total) and each option. Amounts are never read from the document; the server computes the totals and the deposit when you save.
estimate.line.amountPending: Amount computed when saved with a quantity and a price
estimate.addGeneralLine: Add a line without a work package
estimate.error.amount: Enter dollars and cents, for example 125.50.
estimate.textsHint: One entry per line. Write only what applies to this job.
estimate.discountHint: One discount per job, from the active discount rule; it is shown as a totals row before the total, never as a line.
estimate.margin: Known costs {cost}; margin before the discount {margin}
estimate.saved: Draft saved. Amounts and totals were computed on the server.
estimate.totalsPending: The totals appear when every line has a quantity and a price.
estimate.depositNotRequired: Not required under the deposit rule
estimate.totalsHint: As last saved. The total is the sum of the displayed base lines, less any discount row.
estimate.notReady: Not ready to publish yet. The draft is saved; publishing waits for:
estimate.readinessHint: Publishing checks this again on the server.
estimate.line.amountOutdated: Line amount when last saved: {amount}. Save to update it.
estimate.totalsOutdated: These totals, options and amounts are from the last save and do not include your unsaved changes. Save the draft to update them.
estimate.discountStoredBlocked: The discount rule is NOT CONFIGURED, so this discount cannot be saved again. Remove it to save the draft; no discount applies until the rule is configured again.
estimate.discountRemoved: The saved discount will be removed when you save the draft.
estimate.unsaved.title: Your change was not saved
estimate.unsaved.body: Someone else saved this draft first, and the form now shows their version. Your change is listed here so you can enter it again where it still applies; nothing in this list is saved or sent.
estimate.unsaved.none: Your change matched the version you were editing.
estimate.lifecycle.title: Publishing and versions
estimate.lifecycle.currentIs: The current version of this estimate is
estimate.lifecycle.publishHint: Publishing shows this version to the customer and queues the automatic notice “Your HandyHub estimate is ready” (no amounts, only a secure link). A published version is never edited: changes are a new version.
estimate.lifecycle.publishNotReady: Resolve every reason under “Ready to publish?” first.
estimate.lifecycle.publishConfirm: The saved version is published as it is: save your changes first. Its validity starts now, and the version published before it is superseded.
estimate.lifecycle.reviseHint: Revising creates the next version as a draft with the same lines; this version stays as it is. Publishing the new version supersedes the published one.
estimate.lifecycle.declineHint: Kept in the audit log, as the customer gave it.
estimate.lifecycle.withdrawHint: Why it is withdrawn (staff only, kept in the audit log). The customer can no longer accept it.
estimate.lifecycle.expireHint: Why it expires before the end of its validity (staff only, kept in the audit log). The customer can no longer accept it.
estimate.lifecycle.refused: Not done. The server refused it:
estimate.lifecycle.stale: This version changed since you opened it. Reload it and try again.
estimate.lifecycle.failed: The action did not go through. Try again.
estimate.lifecycle.published: Published. The customer notice is queued.
estimate.lifecycle.revisedByOn: Revised from version {n} by {name}, {time, date, medium}
estimate.lifecycle.historyHint: Every version is kept. Superseded and expired versions can never be accepted.
estimate.publishing.title: Who may publish estimates
estimate.publishing.hint: Estimators and the Owner publish estimates directly, without an Owner approval per estimate. A change takes effect at once.
estimate.publishing.saved: Saved. It applies from the next publish.
enum.estimateDocumentRejection.unsupport: Not a PDF or Word (.docx) document.
enum.estimateDocumentRejection.type_mism: The file's content does not match its type.
enum.estimateDocumentRejection.malformed: The file is damaged or not a valid document.
enum.estimateDocumentRejection.trailing_: The file carries extra data after the document.
enum.estimateDocumentRejection.encrypted: The file is encrypted or password-protected.
enum.estimateDocumentRejection.active_co: The file contains scripts, macros, embedded files or external links that are not allowed.
enum.estimateProblem.NOT_CONFIGURED: A required setting is NOT CONFIGURED.
enum.estimateProblem.VERSION_NOT_EDITABL: This version is no longer a draft.
enum.estimateProblem.NO_LINES: Add at least one base-scope line.
enum.estimateProblem.UNIT_PRICE_MISSING: The unit price is not written yet.
enum.estimateProblem.LINE_NOT_POSITIVE: The line amount must be above $0.00.
enum.estimateProblem.NOT_AN_OPTION: Only alternates and add-ons can be options.
enum.estimateProblem.DISCOUNT_NOT_CONFIG: A discount is chosen but the discount rule is NOT CONFIGURED.
enum.estimateProblem.DISCOUNT_CATEGORY_U: The discount category is not in the active discount rule.
enum.estimateProblem.TOTALS_OUTDATED: A setting changed since the last save. Save the draft again to recompute the totals.
enum.estimateProblem.DOCUMENT_PROCESSING: A document is still being checked.
enum.estimateProblem.DOCUMENT_REJECTED: A document was refused; upload another one.
enum.estimateProblem.PDF_REQUIRED: PDF required: upload the PDF of the Word document.
enum.estimateProblem.AGREEMENT_NOT_CONFI: Confirm that the document and the structured amounts agree.
enum.estimateFieldError.NOT_INTEGER_CENT: Enter dollars and cents, for example 125.50.
enum.estimateFieldError.LINE_NOT_FOUND: This line is no longer part of the version. Reload.
enum.estimateFieldError.WORK_PACKAGE_NOT: Not a work package of this project.
enum.estimateFieldError.DISCOUNT_NOT_CON: The discount rule is NOT CONFIGURED.
enum.estimateFieldError.DISCOUNT_CATEGOR: Not a category of the active discount rule.
enum.estimateFieldError.LINE_NOT_POSITIV: The line amount must be above $0.00.
enum.estimateFieldError.VERSION_NOT_EDIT: A published version is not edited.
enum.estimateFieldError.AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE: The line amount is too large.
enum.estimateFieldError.NOT_UPLOADED_MET: This estimate is written in the staff app, not uploaded.
enum.estimateFieldError.PDF_NOT_NEEDED: A PDF original already gives the customer PDF; no second PDF is needed.
enum.estimateFieldError.DOCUMENT_NOT_REA: Both documents must be checked and ready first.
enum.estimateFieldError.TOTALS_INCOMPLET: Enter every amount first: the totals are not computed yet.
enum.estimateRefusal.INVALID_TRANSITION: This is not possible in the version's current state.
enum.estimateRefusal.ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED: This action is not yours to take.
enum.estimateRefusal.REVIEW_HOLD_OPEN: A review hold on the request must be resolved before publishing.
enum.estimateRefusal.STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGU: Document storage is NOT CONFIGURED: the customer PDF cannot be stored.
enum.estimateRefusal.DRAFT_EXISTS: This estimate already has a version being edited; open that draft.
enum.estimateRefusal.ESTIMATE_ACCEPTED: This estimate was accepted; changes to accepted work go through a change order.
enum.estimateRefusal.VERSION_EDITABLE: This version is still being edited; change it directly.
enum.estimateRefusal.NO_NEWER_VERSION: Only publishing a newer version supersedes this one.
enum.estimateRefusal.FACTS_MISSING: The server could not check everything this needs.
enum.queueReason.awaiting_first_response: Waiting for a first meaningful response
enum.requestRefusal.REVIEW_HOLD_OPEN: A review hold must be resolved before estimating.

clock.paused: {time} left; paused outside daily hours until {resume}
clock.stopped: Answered within the target, after {time} in daily hours ({how})
clock.stoppedLate: Answered after the target, after {time} in daily hours ({how})
clock.stoppedUnmeasured: Answered ({how}); the time could not be measured
request.firstResponseHint: The clock counts only during the daily hours. It stops only when a meaningful response is sent or a completed conversation is recorded; opening, assigning, notes, drafts, the four actions and the automatic receipt do not stop it.
request.conversationChannel: How you spoke with the customer
request.conversationOutcomeHint: What was agreed or learned. Customers never see this.
request.hazards: What is the potential hazard about?
request.hazardsHint: Each newly named hazard opens a review hold. Saving again or unticking a hazard never clears its hold.
request.holdsHint: A potential hazard or restricted scope stays visible here until the Owner resolves it with a note and names who reviewed it. Nobody declares the site safe.
request.estimateBlocked: Estimating is blocked until every review hold is resolved.
request.holdCanceled: Cancelled as entered in error by {name}, {time}: {reason}
request.holdReviewerHint: Their name and, where the hazard needs one, their qualification.
request.holdCancelReason: Why it was entered in error
